theme_central: Tawhid in its most condensed formulation: Allah, One, the Absolute upon whom everything depends and who depends on nothing, neither begetting nor begotten.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence.

branches.title: Absolute oneness
branches.resume: Say: He is Allah, One, the Only One sought for all needs.

children.t: Absolute oneness of Allah, the Absolute sought by all

branches.title: Neither begetting nor begotten
branches.resume: He has never begotten, nor was He begotten, and none is equal to Him.

children.t: Neither begetting nor begotten, none equal to Him
